title: Glen Rise Saturday Maths Club
brief: I teach maths at a secondary school in Cork and run the Glen Rise Saturday Maths Club, a free club for children aged 10 to 13 at the Glen Rise Community Centre. This autumn we meet on six Saturdays, 7 November to 12 December 2026, 10:00–12:00, with 20 places. The children work in small groups on puzzles, games and a bit of coding, and nobody is graded. Every session has two Garda-vetted volunteers, and the building is step-free. Parents need a simple page: what the club is, the dates, what to bring (a pencil, a snack and a water bottle), how to sign up, and who runs it. Many parents don't have English as their first language, so keep the words plain and short. Sign-up is by email to mathsclub@glenrise.example for now; a form is fine, but it isn't connected, so it must not say a place was booked. Please don't use any photos of children. No made-up quotes from parents or pupils.

source.adaptation: Teacher's voice from the persona (time-poor, wants a simple page for parents with dates, photo-consent caution). The persona is US K-12; the club is set in Ireland for geographic variety, with Irish safeguarding wording (Garda vetting). Club and centre are fictional; Ireland has no reserved fictional phone range, so contact is email only.
